rage-powder.flavorText: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.

scald.name: scald

scald.flavorText: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

hex.name: hex

phantom-force.name: phantom-force

life-dew.name: life-dew

poltergeist.name: poltergeist

poltergeist.flavorText: The user attacks the target by controlling the target's item. The move fails if the target doesn't have an item.

matcha-gotcha.name: matcha-gotcha

mega-punch.name: mega-punch
mega-punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
mega-punch.flavorText: A powerful punch thrown very hard.

pay-day.name: pay-day

thunder-punch.name: thunder-punch

bind.name: bind

mega-kick.name: mega-kick

mega-kick.flavorText: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

thrash.name: thrash

growl.name: growl

ember.name: ember

ember.flavorText: The foe is attacked with small flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

fire-spin.name: fire-spin

fire-spin.flavorText: Traps foe in fire for 2-5 turns.

lick.name: lick

lick.flavorText: An attack that may cause paralysis.

leech-life.name: leech-life

baton-pass.name: baton-pass

cross-chop.name: cross-chop
cross-chop.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
cross-chop.flavorText: Has a high criti­ cal hit ratio.

fake-out.name: fake-out
fake-out.effect: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle.  Causes the target to flinch.

heat-wave.name: heat-wave
heat-wave.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
heat-wave.flavorText: Exhales a hot breath on the foe. May inflict a burn.

will-o-wisp.name: will-o-wisp
will-o-wisp.flavorText: Inflicts a burn on the foe with intense fire.

superpower.name: superpower
superpower.effect: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
superpower.flavorText: Boosts strength sharply, but lowers abilities.

revenge.name: revenge
revenge.effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
revenge.flavorText: An attack that gains power if injured by the foe.

knock-off.name: knock-off

endeavor.name: endeavor

snatch.name: snatch

blaze-kick.name: blaze-kick

blast-burn.name: blast-burn

overheat.name: overheat

covet.name: covet
covet.flavorText: Cutely begs to obtain an item held by the foe.

embargo.name: embargo

flare-blitz.name: flare-blitz

drain-punch.name: drain-punch

flame-charge.name: flame-charge

quash.name: quash

fire-pledge.name: fire-pledge

work-up.name: work-up

darkest-lariat.name: darkest-lariat

power-trip.name: power-trip

burning-jealousy.name: burning-jealousy

burning-jealousy.flavorText: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

temper-flare.name: temper-flare

wing-attack.name: wing-attack

smokescreen.name: smokescreen
smokescreen.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

belly-drum.flavorText: Reduces own HP to maximize ATTACK.

steel-wing.name: steel-wing
steel-wing.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by one stage.

ancient-power.name: ancient-power
ancient-power.effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
ancient-power.flavorText: An attack that may raise all stats.

beat-up.name: beat-up
beat-up.effect: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.
beat-up.flavorText: Party POKéMON join in the attack.

weather-ball.name: weather-ball
weather-ball.effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.
weather-ball.flavorText: The move’s type and power change with the weather.

air-cutter.name: air-cutter
air-cutter.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
air-cutter.flavorText: Hacks with razorlike wind. High critical-hit ratio.

dragon-dance.name: dragon-dance
dragon-dance.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.
dragon-dance.flavorText: A mystical dance that ups ATTACK and SPEED.

roost.name: roost
roost.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
roost.flavorText: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

tailwind.name: tailwind

defog.name: defog

flame-burst.name: flame-burst
flame-burst.effect: Deals splash damage to Pokémon next to the target.
flame-burst.flavorText: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. The bursting flame damages Pokémon next to the target as well.

echoed-voice.name: echoed-voice

echoed-voice.flavorText: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

sky-drop.name: sky-drop

sky-drop.flavorText: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

inferno.name: inferno
inferno.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
inferno.flavorText: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. It leaves the target with a burn.

hurricane.name: hurricane

hurricane.flavorText: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the target.

mystical-fire.name: mystical-fire
mystical-fire.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
mystical-fire.flavorText: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

dual-wingbeat.name: dual-wingbeat
dual-wingbeat.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
dual-wingbeat.flavorText: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

whirlwind.name: whirlwind
whirlwind.effect: Immediately ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
whirlwind.flavorText: Blows away the foe & ends battle.

sky-attack.name: sky-attack

foresight.name: foresight
foresight.effect: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.

pursuit.name: pursuit
pursuit.effect: Has double power against, and can hit, Pokémon attempting to switch out.

rock-blast.name: rock-blast
rock-blast.flavorText: Hurls boulders at the foe 2 to 5 times in a row.

payback.name: payback
payback.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.
payback.flavorText: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

rock-polish.name: rock-polish
rock-polish.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

ice-fang.name: ice-fang

meteor-beam.name: meteor-beam

thunderbolt.name: thunderbolt

thunderbolt.flavorText: An attack that may cause paralysis.

thunder.name: thunder
thunder.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder.flavorText: An attack that may cause paralysis.

focus-energy.name: focus-energy

focus-energy.flavorText: Raises the criti­ cal hit ratio.

mirror-coat.name: mirror-coat

mirror-coat.flavorText: Counters a SPCL. ATK. move double.

gyro-ball.name: gyro-ball

aura-sphere.name: aura-sphere

heavy-slam.name: heavy-slam

heavy-slam.flavorText: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater its damage.

stomp.name: stomp

psybeam.name: psybeam

psybeam.flavorText: An attack that may confuse the foe.

charge-beam.name: charge-beam

expanding-force.flavorText: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. This move's power goes up and damages all opposing Pokémon on Psychic Terrain.

twin-beam.name: twin-beam
twin-beam.flavorText: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

psychic-noise.name: psychic-noise
psychic-noise.flavorText: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

mist.name: mist
mist.effect: Protects the user’s stats from being changed by enemy moves.

feather-dance.name: feather-dance

muddy-water.name: muddy-water

charm.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

misty-explosion.name: misty-explosion
misty-explosion.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
misty-explosion.flavorText: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is increased on Misty Terrain.

alluring-voice.name: alluring-voice
alluring-voice.flavorText: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

gust.name: gust
gust.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Pokémon in the air.
gust.flavorText: Whips up a strong gust of wind.

leech-seed.name: leech-seed
leech-seed.effect: Seeds the target, stealing HP from it every turn.
leech-seed.flavorText: Steals HP from the foe on every turn.

growth.name: growth
growth.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.

razor-leaf.name: razor-leaf
razor-leaf.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
razor-leaf.flavorText: A sharp-edged leaf is launched to slash at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

poison-powder.name: poison-powder
poison-powder.flavorText: A move that may poison the foe.

dream-eater.name: dream-eater
dream-eater.effect: Only works on sleeping Pokémon.  Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
dream-eater.flavorText: Steals HP from a sleeping victim.

cotton-spore.name: cotton-spore
cotton-spore.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

encore.name: encore
encore.effect: Forces the target to repeat its last used move every turn for 2 to 6 turns.
encore.flavorText: Makes the foe re­ peat 2-6 times.

nature-power.name: nature-power
nature-power.effect: Uses a move which depends upon the terrain.
nature-power.flavorText: The type of attack varies depending on the location.

tickle.name: tickle
tickle.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
tickle.flavorText: Makes the foe laugh to lower ATTACK and DEFENSE.

worry-seed.name: worry-seed
worry-seed.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.
worry-seed.flavorText: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

switcheroo.name: switcheroo
switcheroo.flavorText: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.

cotton-guard.name: cotton-guard
cotton-guard.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.
cotton-guard.flavorText: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically raising the user’s Defense stat.

grassy-glide.name: grassy-glide
grassy-glide.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
grassy-glide.flavorText: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

thunder-shock.name: thunder-shock
thunder-shock.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder-shock.flavorText: An electrical attack that may paralyze the foe.

charge.name: charge
charge.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage.  User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.
charge.flavorText: Charges power to boost the electric move used next.

signal-beam.name: signal-beam
signal-beam.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
signal-beam.flavorText: A strange beam attack that may confuse the foe.

discharge.name: discharge
discharge.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
discharge.flavorText: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike all Pokémon in battle. It may also cause paralysis.

ominous-wind.name: ominous-wind
ominous-wind.effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
ominous-wind.flavorText: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

electro-ball.name: electro-ball
electro-ball.effect: Power is higher when the user has greater Speed than the target, up to a maximum of 150.
electro-ball.flavorText: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.

ally-switch.name: ally-switch
ally-switch.effect: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.
ally-switch.flavorText: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

volt-switch.name: volt-switch
volt-switch.effect: User must switch out after attacking.
volt-switch.flavorText: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

electroweb.name: electroweb
electroweb.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
electroweb.flavorText: The user captures and attacks opposing Pokémon by using an electric net. It reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

eerie-impulse.name: eerie-impulse
eerie-impulse.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.
eerie-impulse.flavorText: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

electric-terrain.name: electric-terrain
electric-terrain.effect: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.
electric-terrain.flavorText: The user electrifies the ground under everyone’s feet for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

rising-voltage.name: rising-voltage
rising-voltage.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
rising-voltage.flavorText: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. This move's power doubles when the target is on Electric Terrain.

vine-whip.name: vine-whip
vine-whip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
vine-whip.flavorText: Whips the foe with slender vines.

petal-dance.name: petal-dance
petal-dance.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.

synthesis.name: synthesis
synthesis.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.

wish.name: wish
wish.effect: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.
wish.flavorText: A wish that restores HP. It takes time to work.

aromatherapy.name: aromatherapy
aromatherapy.effect: Cures the entire party of major status effects.
aromatherapy.flavorText: Heals all status problems with a soothing scent.

lucky-chant.name: lucky-chant
lucky-chant.effect: Prevents the target from scoring critical hits for five turns.
lucky-chant.flavorText: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

after-you.name: after-you
after-you.effect: Makes the target act next this turn.
after-you.flavorText: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

petal-blizzard.name: petal-blizzard
petal-blizzard.flavorText: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

light-of-ruin.name: light-of-ruin
light-of-ruin.effect: User receives 1/2 the damage inflicted in recoil.
light-of-ruin.flavorText: Drawing power from the Eternal Flower, the user fires a powerful beam of light. This also damages the user quite a lot.

ice-punch.name: ice-punch
ice-punch.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
ice-punch.flavorText: An icy punch. May cause freezing.

rock-throw.name: rock-throw
rock-throw.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

mud-slap.name: mud-slap
mud-slap.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

block.name: block
block.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
block.flavorText: Blocks the foe’s way to prevent escape.

avalanche.name: avalanche
avalanche.effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
avalanche.flavorText: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

chip-away.name: chip-away
chip-away.flavorText: Looking for an opening, the user strikes continually. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

slam.name: slam
slam.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
slam.flavorText: Slams the foe with a tail, vine, etc.

wrap.name: wrap
wrap.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

haze.name: haze
haze.effect: Resets all Pokémon’s stats, accuracy, and evasion.

metronome.name: metronome
metronome.effect: Randomly selects and uses any move in the game.

twister.name: twister
twister.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
twister.flavorText: Whips up a tornado to attack.

extreme-speed.name: extreme-speed
extreme-speed.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

dive.name: dive
dive.effect: User dives underwater, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
dive.flavorText: Dives underwater the first turn and strikes next turn.

ice-spinner.name: ice-spinner
ice-spinner.flavorText: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

disable.name: disable
disable.effect: Disables the target’s last used move for 1-8 turns.
disable.flavorText: Disables the foe's most recent move.

rage.name: rage
rage.effect: If the user is hit after using this move, its Attack rises by one stage.
rage.flavorText: Raises ATTACK if the user is hit.

dizzy-punch.name: dizzy-punch
dizzy-punch.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
dizzy-punch.flavorText: An attack that may cause confusion.

crush-claw.name: crush-claw
crush-claw.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
crush-claw.flavorText: Tears at the foe with sharp claws. May lower DEFENSE.

hammer-arm.name: hammer-arm
hammer-arm.effect: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
hammer-arm.flavorText: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

trump-card.name: trump-card
trump-card.effect: Power increases when this move has less PP, up to a maximum of 200.
trump-card.flavorText: The fewer PP this move has, the more power it has for attack.

sucker-punch.name: sucker-punch
sucker-punch.effect: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
sucker-punch.flavorText: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

circle-throw.name: circle-throw
circle-throw.effect: Ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
circle-throw.flavorText: The user throws the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

razor-wind.name: razor-wind
razor-wind.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.

feint.name: feint
feint.flavorText: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

bullet-punch.name: bullet-punch
bullet-punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
bullet-punch.flavorText: The user strikes with a tough punch as fast as a bullet. This move always goes first.

bug-bite.name: bug-bite
bug-bite.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
bug-bite.flavorText: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

harden.name: harden
harden.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.
harden.flavorText: Stiffens the body’s  muscles to raise DEFENSE.

self-destruct.name: self-destruct
self-destruct.flavorText: Powerful but makes the user faint.

acid-armor.name: acid-armor
acid-armor.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

spiky-shield.name: spiky-shield
spiky-shield.effect: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.
spiky-shield.flavorText: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker who makes direct contact.

mortal-spin.name: mortal-spin
mortal-spin.flavorText: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

skull-bash.name: skull-bash
skull-bash.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.  User charges for one turn before attacking.

bubble.name: bubble
bubble.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
bubble.flavorText: An attack that may reduce SPEED.

flail.name: flail
flail.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
flail.flavorText: Stronger if the user's HP is low.

rapid-spin.name: rapid-spin
rapid-spin.effect: Frees the user from binding moves, removes Leech Seed, and blows away Spikes.

yawn.name: yawn
yawn.effect: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.
yawn.flavorText: Lulls the foe into yawning, then sleeping next turn.

hydro-cannon.name: hydro-cannon
hydro-cannon.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
hydro-cannon.flavorText: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.

water-spout.name: water-spout
water-spout.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
water-spout.flavorText: Inflicts more damage if the user’s HP is high.

aqua-ring.name: aqua-ring
aqua-ring.effect: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP each turn.
aqua-ring.flavorText: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

aqua-jet.name: aqua-jet
aqua-jet.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
aqua-jet.flavorText: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

shell-smash.name: shell-smash
shell-smash.effect: Raises user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages.  Lower user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
shell-smash.flavorText: The user breaks its shell, lowering its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply raising Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

water-pledge.name: water-pledge
water-pledge.effect: With Grass Pledge, halves opposing Pokémon’s Speed for four turns.
water-pledge.flavorText: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, the damage increases and a rainbow appears.

terrain-pulse.name: terrain-pulse
terrain-pulse.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
terrain-pulse.flavorText: The user utilizes the power of the terrain to attack. This move's type and power changes depending on the terrain when it's used.

flip-turn.name: flip-turn
flip-turn.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flip-turn.flavorText: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

wave-crash.name: wave-crash
wave-crash.flavorText: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user and raises the user’s action speed.

headbutt.name: headbutt
headbutt.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
headbutt.flavorText: An attack that may make foe flinch.

super-fang.name: super-fang
super-fang.effect: Inflicts damage equal to half the target’s HP.

bullet-seed.name: bullet-seed
bullet-seed.flavorText: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds in a row to strike the foe.

leafage.name: leafage
leafage.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
leafage.flavorText: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

spicy-extract.name: spicy-extract
spicy-extract.flavorText: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

peck.name: peck
peck.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
peck.flavorText: Jabs the foe with a beak, etc.

drill-peck.name: drill-peck
drill-peck.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

pluck.name: pluck
pluck.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
pluck.flavorText: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

mud-sport.name: mud-sport
mud-sport.flavorText: Covers the user in mud to raise electrical resistance.

magnet-rise.name: magnet-rise
magnet-rise.effect: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.
magnet-rise.flavorText: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

drill-run.name: drill-run
drill-run.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
drill-run.flavorText: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

rototiller.name: rototiller
rototiller.effect: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all Grass Pokémon in battle.
rototiller.flavorText: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of Grass-type Pokémon.

smart-strike.name: smart-strike
smart-strike.flavorText: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

powder-snow.name: powder-snow
powder-snow.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
powder-snow.flavorText: An attack that may cause freezing.

destiny-bond.name: destiny-bond
destiny-bond.effect: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.
destiny-bond.flavorText: The foe faints if the user does.

icicle-spear.name: icicle-spear
icicle-spear.flavorText: Attacks the foe by firing 2 to 5 icicles in a row.

wake-up-slap.name: wake-up-slap
wake-up-slap.effect: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.
wake-up-slap.flavorText: This attack inflicts high damage on a sleeping foe. It also wakes the foe up, however.

ice-shard.name: ice-shard
ice-shard.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
ice-shard.flavorText: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

captivate.name: captivate
captivate.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages if it’s the opposite gender.
captivate.flavorText: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

frost-breath.name: frost-breath
frost-breath.flavorText: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

aurora-veil.name: aurora-veil
aurora-veil.effect: Reduces damage five turns, but must be used during hail.
aurora-veil.flavorText: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.

triple-axel.name: triple-axel
triple-axel.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
triple-axel.flavorText: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

slack-off.name: slack-off
slack-off.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
slack-off.flavorText: Slacks off and restores half the maximum HP.

pound.name: pound
pound.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
pound.flavorText: Pounds with fore­ legs or tail.

sing.name: sing
sing.flavorText: May cause the foe to fall asleep.

bubble-beam.name: bubble-beam
bubble-beam.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
bubble-beam.flavorText: An attack that may lower SPEED.

perish-song.name: perish-song
perish-song.effect: User and target both faint after three turns.
perish-song.flavorText: Both user and foe faint in 3 turns.

wonder-room.name: wonder-room
wonder-room.effect: All Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped for 5 turns.
wonder-room.flavorText: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

sparkling-aria.name: sparkling-aria
sparkling-aria.flavorText: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be healed by the touch of these bubbles.

tri-attack.name: tri-attack
tri-attack.effect: Has a chance to burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
tri-attack.flavorText: Fires three kinds of beams at once.

lock-on.name: lock-on
lock-on.effect: Ensures that the user’s next move will hit the target.
lock-on.flavorText: Ensures the next attack will hit.

infestation.name: infestation
infestation.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
infestation.flavorText: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can’t flee during this time.

dragon-darts.name: dragon-darts
dragon-darts.flavorText: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each target once.

pounce.name: pounce
pounce.flavorText: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

sleep-powder.name: sleep-powder
sleep-powder.flavorText: May cause the foe to fall asleep.

sweet-scent.name: sweet-scent
sweet-scent.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.

frenzy-plant.name: frenzy-plant
frenzy-plant.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
frenzy-plant.flavorText: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.

grass-pledge.name: grass-pledge
grass-pledge.effect: With Fire Pledge, damages opposing Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP every turn for four turns.
grass-pledge.flavorText: A column of grass hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its water equivalent, its damage increases into a vast swamp.

hypnosis.name: hypnosis
hypnosis.flavorText: May put the foe to sleep.

explosion.name: explosion
explosion.flavorText: Very powerful but makes user faint.

nightmare.name: nightmare
nightmare.effect: Target loses 1/4 its max HP every turn as long as it’s asleep.
nightmare.flavorText: A sleeper loses 1/4 HP every turn.

mean-look.name: mean-look
mean-look.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

role-play.name: role-play
role-play.flavorText: Mimics the target and copies its special ability.

shadow-punch.name: shadow-punch
shadow-punch.flavorText: An unavoidable punch that is thrown from shadows.

teleport.name: teleport
teleport.effect: Immediately ends wild battles.  No effect otherwise.
teleport.flavorText: A move for fleeing from battle.

recycle.name: recycle
recycle.effect: User recovers the item it last used up.
recycle.flavorText: Recycles a used item for one more use.

healing-wish.name: healing-wish
healing-wish.effect: User faints.  Its replacement has its HP fully restored and any major status effect removed.
healing-wish.flavorText: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

magic-room.name: magic-room
magic-room.effect: Negates held items for five turns.
magic-room.flavorText: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.

heal-pulse.name: heal-pulse
heal-pulse.effect: Heals the target for half its max HP.
heal-pulse.flavorText: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

detect.name: detect
detect.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
detect.flavorText: Evades attack that turn. It may fail.

me-first.name: me-first
me-first.effect: Uses the target’s move against it before it attacks, with power increased by half.
me-first.flavorText: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

quick-guard.name: quick-guard
quick-guard.effect: Prevents any priority moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.
quick-guard.flavorText: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

power-up-punch.name: power-up-punch
power-up-punch.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
power-up-punch.flavorText: Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.

spark.name: spark
spark.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
spark.flavorText: An attack that may cause paralysis.

odor-sleuth.name: odor-sleuth
odor-sleuth.effect: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.
odor-sleuth.flavorText: Negates the foe’s efforts to heighten evasiveness.

howl.name: howl
howl.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
howl.flavorText: Howls to raise the spirit and boosts ATTACK.

wild-charge.name: wild-charge
wild-charge.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
wild-charge.flavorText: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.

recover.name: recover
recover.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
recover.flavorText: Recovers up to half the user’s maximum HP.

kinesis.name: kinesis
kinesis.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

miracle-eye.name: miracle-eye
miracle-eye.effect: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
miracle-eye.flavorText: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

psycho-cut.name: psycho-cut
psycho-cut.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
psycho-cut.flavorText: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

bounce.name: bounce
bounce.effect: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
bounce.flavorText: Bounces up, then down the next turn. May paralyze.

jump-kick.name: jump-kick
jump-kick.effect: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.

defense-curl.name: defense-curl
defense-curl.effect: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.

high-jump-kick.name: high-jump-kick
high-jump-kick.effect: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.
high-jump-kick.flavorText: May miss and hurt the user.

entrainment.name: entrainment
entrainment.effect: Copies the user’s ability onto the target.
entrainment.flavorText: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.

smog.name: smog
smog.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
smog.flavorText: An attack that may poison the foe.

moonlight.name: moonlight
moonlight.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.

flatter.name: flatter
flatter.effect: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage and confuses the target.
flatter.flavorText: Confuses the foe, but raises its SP. ATK.

punishment.name: punishment
punishment.effect: Power increases against targets with more raised stats, up to a maximum of 200.
punishment.flavorText: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.

shadow-sneak.name: shadow-sneak
shadow-sneak.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
shadow-sneak.flavorText: The user extends its shadow and attacks the foe from behind. This move always goes first.

refresh.name: refresh
refresh.effect: Cleanses the user of a burn, paralysis, or poison.
refresh.flavorText: Heals poisoning, paralysis, or a burn.

natural-gift.name: natural-gift
natural-gift.effect: Power and type depend on the held berry.
natural-gift.flavorText: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

autotomize.name: autotomize
autotomize.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages and halves the user’s weight.
autotomize.flavorText: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

leaf-blade.name: leaf-blade
leaf-blade.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
leaf-blade.flavorText: Slashes with a sharp leaf. High critical-hit ratio.

mirror-move.name: mirror-move
mirror-move.effect: Uses the target’s last used move.

morning-sun.name: morning-sun
morning-sun.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.

aurora-beam.name: aurora-beam
aurora-beam.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
aurora-beam.flavorText: An attack that may lower ATTACK.

lava-plume.name: lava-plume
lava-plume.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
lava-plume.flavorText: An inferno of scarlet flames washes over all Pokémon in battle. It may also inflict burns.

grass-whistle.name: grass-whistle
grass-whistle.flavorText: Lulls the foe into sleep with a pleasant melody.

solar-blade.name: solar-blade
solar-blade.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
solar-blade.flavorText: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light’s energy, attacking the target on the next turn.

barrier.name: barrier
barrier.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

freeze-dry.name: freeze-dry
freeze-dry.flavorText: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.

incinerate.name: incinerate
incinerate.flavorText: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

torch-song.name: torch-song
torch-song.flavorText: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

pollen-puff.name: pollen-puff
pollen-puff.effect: Damages opponents, but heals allies for 50% of their max HP.
pollen-puff.flavorText: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

flower-trick.name: flower-trick
flower-trick.flavorText: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

aqua-step.name: aqua-step
aqua-step.flavorText: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

aqua-cutter.name: aqua-cutter
aqua-cutter.flavorText: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

spirit-shackle.name: spirit-shackle
spirit-shackle.flavorText: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target’s shadow to the ground to prevent the target from escaping.

skitter-smack.name: skitter-smack
skitter-smack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
skitter-smack.flavorText: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

flame-wheel.name: flame-wheel
flame-wheel.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.  Lets frozen Pokémon thaw themselves.
flame-wheel.flavorText: An attack that may cause a burn.

mach-punch.name: mach-punch
mach-punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
mach-punch.flavorText: A fast punch that lands first.

raging-fury.name: raging-fury
raging-fury.flavorText: The user rampages and spews vicious flames to inflict damage on the target, then becomes fixated on using this move.

rollout.name: rollout
rollout.effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.

eruption.name: eruption
eruption.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
eruption.flavorText: The higher the user’s HP, the more damage caused.

extrasensory.name: extrasensory
extrasensory.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
extrasensory.flavorText: Attacks with a peculiar power. May cause flinching.

burn-up.name: burn-up
burn-up.effect: Removes the user’s Fire type after inflicting damage.
burn-up.flavorText: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.

glare.name: glare
glare.flavorText: A move that may cause paralysis.

wring-out.name: wring-out
wring-out.effect: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.
wring-out.flavorText: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack’s power.

gastro-acid.name: gastro-acid
gastro-acid.effect: Nullifies target’s ability until it leaves battle.
gastro-acid.flavorText: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.

coil.name: coil
coil.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.
coil.flavorText: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

leaf-tornado.name: leaf-tornado
leaf-tornado.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
leaf-tornado.flavorText: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.

string-shot.name: string-shot
string-shot.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
string-shot.flavorText: A move that lowers the foe's SPEED.

silver-wind.name: silver-wind
silver-wind.effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
silver-wind.flavorText: A powdery attack that may raise abilities.

bug-buzz.name: bug-buzz
bug-buzz.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
bug-buzz.flavorText: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

quiver-dance.name: quiver-dance
quiver-dance.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.
quiver-dance.flavorText: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. It boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

struggle-bug.name: struggle-bug
struggle-bug.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
struggle-bug.flavorText: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets’ Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

fiery-dance.name: fiery-dance
fiery-dance.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
fiery-dance.flavorText: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and flaps its wings. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

lunge.name: lunge
lunge.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
lunge.flavorText: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

power-whip.name: power-whip
power-whip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
power-whip.flavorText: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.

play-nice.name: play-nice
play-nice.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
play-nice.flavorText: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

aromatic-mist.name: aromatic-mist
aromatic-mist.effect: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.
aromatic-mist.flavorText: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

magic-powder.name: magic-powder
magic-powder.flavorText: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.

gigaton-hammer.name: gigaton-hammer
gigaton-hammer.flavorText: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

salt-cure.name: salt-cure
salt-cure.flavorText: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

crabhammer.name: crabhammer
crabhammer.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
crabhammer.flavorText: Has a high criti­ cal hit ratio.

sky-uppercut.name: sky-uppercut
sky-uppercut.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Bounce and Fly users.
sky-uppercut.flavorText: An uppercut thrown as if leaping into the sky.

cross-poison.name: cross-poison
cross-poison.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
cross-poison.flavorText: A slashing attack that may also leave the target poisoned. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

mud-bomb.name: mud-bomb
mud-bomb.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
mud-bomb.flavorText: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

icicle-crash.name: icicle-crash
icicle-crash.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
icicle-crash.flavorText: The user attacks by harshly dropping an icicle onto the target. It may also make the target flinch.

poison-sting.name: poison-sting
poison-sting.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
poison-sting.flavorText: An attack that may poison the target.

venom-drench.name: venom-drench
venom-drench.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.
venom-drench.flavorText: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

baneful-bunker.name: baneful-bunker
baneful-bunker.effect: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn and poisons any Pokémon that tries to use a contact move on it.
baneful-bunker.flavorText: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.

grudge.name: grudge
grudge.effect: If the user faints this turn, the PP of the move that fainted it drops to 0.
grudge.flavorText: If the user faints, deletes the PP of the final move.

sheer-cold.name: sheer-cold
sheer-cold.flavorText: A chilling attack that causes fainting if it hits.

tail-slap.name: tail-slap
tail-slap.flavorText: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.

clear-smog.name: clear-smog
clear-smog.effect: Removes all of the target’s stat modifiers.
clear-smog.flavorText: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

belch.name: belch
belch.effect: Can only be used after the user has eaten a berry.
belch.flavorText: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

steel-roller.name: steel-roller
steel-roller.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
steel-roller.flavorText: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

supercell-slam.name: supercell-slam
supercell-slam.flavorText: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

heal-block.name: heal-block
heal-block.effect: Prevents target from restoring its HP for five turns.
heal-block.flavorText: The user prevents the foe from using any HP-recovery moves for five turns.

mirror-shot.name: mirror-shot
mirror-shot.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
mirror-shot.flavorText: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

crafty-shield.name: crafty-shield
crafty-shield.effect: Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves.
crafty-shield.flavorText: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.

fairy-lock.name: fairy-lock
fairy-lock.effect: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.
fairy-lock.flavorText: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.

armor-cannon.name: armor-cannon
armor-cannon.flavorText: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

bitter-blade.name: bitter-blade
bitter-blade.flavorText: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

acid.name: acid
acid.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
acid.flavorText: An attack that may lower DEFENSE.

razor-shell.name: razor-shell
razor-shell.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
razor-shell.flavorText: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This attack may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

eerie-spell.name: eerie-spell
eerie-spell.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
eerie-spell.flavorText: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

chilly-reception.name: chilly-reception
chilly-reception.flavorText: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

poison-gas.name: poison-gas
poison-gas.flavorText: A move that may poison the foe.

poison-fang.name: poison-fang
poison-fang.effect: Has a chance to badly poison the target.
poison-fang.flavorText: A sharp-fanged attack. May badly poison the foe.

fire-lash.name: fire-lash
fire-lash.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
fire-lash.flavorText: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

corrosive-gas.name: corrosive-gas
corrosive-gas.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
corrosive-gas.flavorText: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
